campaign_name: Unit-of-Work v3.1 Milestone 2: Atomic Cost Representation & Measurement Semantics Qualification
governing_principles: Production Cost != Market Price != Consumer Value
Economic Optimizer Proposes -> UoW Authority Certifies -> State Changes
C(u) = C_H + C_M + C_E + C_R + C_K + C_D

dimensions.C_H: Human work cost (review, manual approval, supervision)

qualification_gates.name: Component-Wise Atomic Accounting
qualification_gates.criteria: Every atomic UoW carries a reproducible cost observation across the 6 orthogonal cost dimensions; total equals sum of components.

qualification_gates.name: Recursive Composition Conservation
qualification_gates.criteria: Recursive composition preserves total cost: C(U) = sum_i(C(U_i)) + C_composition.

qualification_gates.name: Heterogeneous Realization Equivalence
qualification_gates.criteria: Different valid realizations of identical semantic work are comparable without mutating the work contract or state delta.

qualification_gates.name: Friction vs. Necessary Work Separation
qualification_gates.criteria: Friction cost is strictly isolated: C_F = C_observed - C* >= 0, and necessary work C* is invariant to operational friction.

qualification_gates.name: Evidence-Bound Replay Determinism
qualification_gates.criteria: Cost observations are cryptographically linked to evidence logs; log/WAL replay yields identical observations, and tampering triggers immediate verification failure.

qualification_gates.name: Policy/Authority Non-Escalation Boundary
qualification_gates.criteria: Economic optimizers propose candidate allocations; authority gates independently certify validity; lowest cost never gains automatic transition authority.
